### Niagen Bioscience Launches Niagen™ Plus Liquid At-Home Injections to Support Telehealth Expansion


October 22, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/770776702/files/doc_news/Niagen-Bioscience-Launches-Niagen-Plus-Liquid-At-Home-Injections-to-Support-Telehealth-Expansion-2026.pdf)


*Liquid formulation of Niagen™ Plus simplifies at-home administration and is the only at-home injection with clinical outcomes associated with reduced fatigue and improved sleep and skin*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=2f3910eff7a0bfef9b1a3e20ab552d87) (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced the launch of the clinician-directed, prescription-only pharmaceutical-grade[Niagen](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com%2Fproducts%2Fniagen-at-home-injection-kit-liquid&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen&index=2&md5=0f03416c0bb4f22af983543ab1e1c9ce)[™](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com%2Fproducts%2Fniagen-at-home-injection-kit-liquid&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=%26%238482%3B&index=3&md5=0b4babf906e51daab2a4f3bbb0daf833)[At-Home Injection Kit](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com%2Fproducts%2Fniagen-at-home-injection-kit-liquid&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=At-Home+Injection+Kit&index=4&md5=4696a1db4e35554d30a0dfd3dcbc62c1) , featuring the Company’s first ready-to-inject liquid formulation with[Niagen™](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com%2Fproducts%2Fniagen-at-home-injection-kit-liquid&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen%26%238482%3B&index=5&md5=b2efc1a92cce540e66dae333ea55b4d6) (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most studied, high-quality NAD+ precursor brand available, now available through its[Niagen™ Plus](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com%2F&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen%26%238482%3B+Plus&index=6&md5=aab128e9f701bd2c751c5dbc34e8c876) telehealth platform.


Liquid formulation of Niagen Plus simplifies at-home administration and is the only at-home injection with clinical outcomes associated with reduced fatigue and improved sleep and skin


NAD+ injections are increasingly available, yet no published clinical studies have evaluated subcutaneous (sub-q) or intramuscular (IM) NAD+ injections. In contrast, Niagen Bioscience published two pilot clinical studies of sub-q and IM Niagen injections on medRxiv. In these open-label pilot studies, injectable Niagen was well tolerated, including over 90 days of at-home use. Exploratory, self-reported outcomes were associated with reduced fatigue and improved sleep and skin. These findings require confirmation in larger, placebo-controlled studies ([Nkrumah-Elie et al., 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.medrxiv.org%2Fcontent%2F10.64898%2F2026.10.12.26365345v1&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Nkrumah-Elie+et+al.%2C+2026&index=7&md5=22ae061faf324ff912e473bc46e66874) ;[Russ et al., 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.medrxiv.org%2Fcontent%2F10.64898%2F2026.10.13.26365470v1&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Russ+et+al.%2C+2026&index=8&md5=6ee69eecaf8cf6b4e48d7469075ea933) ).


“The liquid Niagen At-Home Injection Kit is a meaningful step in building Niagen Plus into a scalable telehealth platform,” said Rob Fried, Chief Executive Officer of Niagen Bioscience. “Additionally, telehealth partners are central to how we intend to scale Niagen Plus. We believe a ready-to-inject format with fewer steps, backed by new pilot clinical data, provides a superior product for telehealth partners, extending reach beyond our own direct-to-patient channel.”


Each kit includes a sterile, multi-dose 5 mL vial with 500 mg of Niagen, syringes, and alcohol prep pads. Patients simply draw the clinician-prescribed dose and inject subcutaneously: fewer components, fewer steps. The program remains clinician-directed and prescription-only. Patients complete an online intake form, a licensed provider decides whether to prescribe, and if prescribed, the medication is dispensed from state-licensed 503A compounding pharmacies and shipped to their door. NiagenPlus.com is LegitScript Certified, an independent third-party certification for healthcare merchants and telehealth platforms.


**Study Highlights**


Two open-label pilot studies evaluated the safety and tolerability of injectable Niagen in 39 generally healthy adults with elevated fatigue ([Nkrumah-Elie et al., 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.medrxiv.org%2Fcontent%2F10.64898%2F2026.10.12.26365345v1&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Nkrumah-Elie+et+al.%2C+2026&index=9&md5=e54f0efcd1c87588d0454fce565d08c7) ;[Russ et al., 2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.medrxiv.org%2Fcontent%2F10.64898%2F2026.10.13.26365470v1&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Russ+et+al.%2C+2026&index=10&md5=11df6e901655299ecf9b19305770816a) ). Participants were randomized to 50 mg or 100 mg of Niagen by IM or sub-q injection for three days under clinical supervision, then self-administered subcutaneous Niagen at home three times weekly for an additional 90 days. Building on the safety data, these pilot studies also feature the first exploratory findings on IM and sub-q Niagen injections.


**Findings:**


- Three days of supervised injections followed by 90 days of self-injection were well tolerated with no unexpected adverse events reported.
- At-home sub-q self-administered Niagen injections were achievable under protocol-defined conditions, supporting the feasibility of at-home administration.
- Blood NAD+ levels remained stable over the 90 days.
- Repeated Niagen injections were associated with improvements in fatigue, sleep impairment (e.g., daytime sleepiness), and quality of life, as assessed using validated participant-reported outcome questionnaires, as well as self-reported improvements in skin health.
- The study observed changes in markers of mitochondrial bioenergetics (efficient cellular energy production) and reductions in several oxidative stress markers (less cellular wear and tear). Because the study was open-label and not placebo-controlled, these findings are exploratory and require confirmation.


More on these findings can be found on[www.aboutnad.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.aboutnad.com&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=www.aboutnad.com&index=11&md5=1522864e3db45137fa79864e081d69f5) in the following blog posts:[Nicotinamide Riboside Injections: What Two New Pilot Studies Reveal About Safety](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aboutnad.com%2Fblogs%2Fblog%2Fnicotinamide-riboside-injections-what-two-new-pilot-studies-reveal-about-safety&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Nicotinamide+Riboside+Injections%3A+What+Two+New+Pilot+Studies+Reveal+About+Safety&index=12&md5=0ea7eedea57fb48400c21e4d38ad9e05) and[Nicotinamide Riboside Injections: Exploratory Findings from a Two-Part Pilot Study](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aboutnad.com%2Fblogs%2Fblog%2Fnicotinamide-riboside-injections-exploratory-findings-from-a-two-part-pilot-study&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Nicotinamide+Riboside+Injections%3A+Exploratory+Findings+from+a+Two-Part+Pilot+Study&index=13&md5=75044f75f036f298c8f72c98373207d1) *.*

**About Niagen Bioscience**


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=15&md5=fb4e6053184321586750e1b6e405e343) (NASDAQ: NAGE) is the global authority in healthy aging and NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) science. As a trusted pioneer of NAD+ discoveries, Niagen Bioscience™ is dedicated to advancing healthspan through precision science and innovative NAD+-boosting solutions.


The Niagen Bioscience team, composed of world-renowned scientists, works with independent investigators from esteemed universities and research institutions around the globe to uncover the full potential of NAD+. A vital coenzyme found in every cell of the human body, NAD+ declines with age and exposure to everyday lifestyle stressors. NAD+ depletion is a key contributor to age-related changes in health and vitality.


Distinguished by state-of-the-art laboratories, rigorous scientific and quality protocols, and collaborations with leading research institutions worldwide, Niagen Bioscience sets the gold standard for research, quality, and innovation. There’s a better way to age.


At the heart of its clinically tested product portfolio is Niagen® (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most efficient, well-researched, and high-quality NAD+ booster available. Niagen powers the Company’s consumer supplement, Tru Niagen®, the number one NAD+ boosting oral supplement in the United States† (available at[www.truniagen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.truniagen.com&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=www.truniagen.com&index=16&md5=29d17f3d57165ebd3490ff90e799cdbc) ), and Niagen™ Plus, featuring pharmaceutical-grade intravenous (IV) and injectable Niagen products ([www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=17&md5=ba7bc5be0392f4948204e3d3a7d3a2f6) ). Pharmaceutical-grade Niagen™ IV and injections are compounded and distributed by U.S. FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities and are available exclusively at clinics with a prescription. NAD Pharmaceuticals Corp., the Company’s wholly owned subsidiary focused on developing therapies for accelerated aging and rare genetic diseases, is conducting research on NB4168, a differentiated small molecule.


Niagen Bioscience’s robust patent portfolio protects NR and other NAD+ precursors. Niagen Bioscience maintains a website at[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54627067&newsitemid=20261022816058&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=18&md5=a8bf4228dd480f458f8a4c2fc6b72d73) , where copies of press releases, news, and financial information are regularly published.
